name: Category Post Page List Widget
author: S Abdullah Prem

sections.description:
Displays pages or posts from a category, excluding the current one, with options for list styles: plain, bullet, or numbered.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin:
    Upload the category-post-page-list-widget folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your WordPress site.

  2. Activate the Plugin:
    Go to the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard and activate the Category Post Page List Widget plugin.

  3. Add the Widget:
    Navigate to Appearance > Widgets.
    Select the desired widget area (e.g., Sidebar or Footer).
    Drag and drop the Category Post Page List Widget into the chosen widget area.

  4. Configure Widget Settings:
    Click on the widget to configure its settings as needed (e.g., selecting categories, display options).

  5. Save Changes:
    After configuring, make sure to save your changes to apply the widget settings.
sections.faq:
How do I use this plugin?

Simply add the widget to your sidebar and configure the settings to list pages or posts from the specified category.
